walkthroughs.body_html:
Aspects of French-speaking Society: Current Issues — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Aspects of French-speaking Society: Current Issues brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Aspects of French-speaking Society: Current Issues.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which French verb form correctly says 'I would have helped' (j'... aidé)?
options: aurai
aurais
avait
étais

mcqs.q: Which conjunction always triggers the subjunctive?
options: parce que
car
bien que
puisque

mcqs.q: Which verbs take 'être' as their auxiliary in the passé composé?
options: All verbs take avoir.
Just movement verbs - never reflexives.
Movement/state-change verbs (DR & MRS VAN DER TRAMP) and all reflexive verbs.
Either position with the same meaning.

mcqs.q: What is the 'vous' form of 'être' in the present tense?
options: est.
êtes.
êtez.
All verbs take avoir.

mcqs.q: Where does 'petit' usually go in relation to its noun?
options: All verbs take avoir.
After the noun like most French adjectives.
Before the noun (un petit garçon).
Either position with the same meaning.
